name: starfield-modding
description: Skills and guard hooks for Starfield mod authors: set up, start, build, rebuild, evaluate and test mods with free public tools, and keep the agent out of the game's Data and saves folders.

game_dir.title: Starfield game folder (optional)
game_dir.description: The folder that holds Starfield.exe, if it is not a normal Steam or Game Pass install. Its Data folder is guarded. Leave empty to detect it.

saves_dir.title: Starfield saves folder (optional)
saves_dir.description: Only if your saves are not in Documents\My Games\Starfield\Saves. The folder is guarded. Leave empty to detect it.

papyrus_ref.title: sf-papyrus-ref folder (optional)
papyrus_ref.description: The folder that holds sf_papyrus_ref.py. The Papyrus lookups and the official-script check use it. Leave empty if it is on PATH or not installed.
